record.question: An Automobile is:
options: a self propelled vehicle which is used for transportation of goods and passengers on the ground
that in which power required for the propulsion is produced from within
a name for the self propelled vehicle running on the ground
record.explanation: The January 2014 paper (Q2) asks for the definition of an automobile. Option (a) gives the complete definition, a self-propelled vehicle carrying goods and passengers on the ground; (d) is close but omits the transport purpose.
